backend_identity.requirement: G9 must verify the observed T4 identity against the W0b record via scripts/t4_backend_identity.py; any drift is fail-closed

claims_not_supported: no CFD primal qualification (sampled sphere on T4 is W2-T4b)
no SDF gradient, reverse-mode or Enzyme qualification
no v16 geometry behavior or optimizer claim
no change to the CPU-qualified W1 semantics or evidence
claims_supported: the device GridSDF is an explicit derived copy of the canonical CPU phi with a recorded source SHA-256
the WaterLily body measurement path (trilinear value and analytic normal) compiles and executes inside a CUDA kernel
CPU and GPU geometry evaluation agree within the registered tolerances
the outside positive-fluid extension is exact and no scalar-indexing fallback is enabled

canonical_phi.construction: the registered W2a synthetic sphere fixture (exact float64 sphere SDF cast to Float32, gate constructor at margin 0.15 m)

fixture.comparison_units: world meters (body-returned solver-unit distance multiplied by world_per_solver)

device_copy.representation: GridSDF with phi::CuArray{Float32,3} and Float32 origin/h/outside/margin fields, built through the raw (gate-free) constructor after the canonical CPU gate has passed
device_copy.source_sha_rule: sha256 of the column-major Float32 bytes of the canonical numpy-compatible phi array (Julia vec order); the device read-back uses the same byte rule

probes.generation: host-side Julia MersenneTwister seed 202606; box probes uniform in the canonical design box; band probes = sphere direction (uniform solid angle) x radial offset uniform in [-0.001, 0.001] m; both evaluated identically by CPU and GPU
probes.normal_gate_subset: probes whose canonical fractional cell coordinates all lie in [1e-4, 1-1e-4]; probes outside the subset are recorded and excluded from the normal bound only
representative: outside design box on all six faces

fixture.reference_cpu_path: the CPU-qualified W1/W2a body path: canonical Float32 phi with Float64 origin/h fields and Float64 trilinear arithmetic

gates_registered_before_measurement.G1_device_copy_source_sha: device read-back phi sha256 equals the canonical source phi sha256; the canonical CPU phi remains the authoritative artifact
gates_registered_before_measurement.G2_kernel_executes: the bulk CUDA probe kernel compiles and returns for all registered probes
gates_registered_before_measurement.G3_finite: all CPU and GPU value/normal outputs are finite
gates_registered_before_measurement.G4_sign_classification: for every inside-box probe with |phi_cpu_world| > 1e-5 m, sign(phi_gpu_world) == sign(phi_cpu_world); probes within the degenerate band are recorded, not gated
gates_registered_before_measurement.G5_value_bound: max |phi_gpu_world - phi_cpu_world| <= 1e-5 m over all inside-box probes
gates_registered_before_measurement.G6_normal_bound: max ||n_gpu - n_cpu||_2 <= 1e-3 over the registered normal-gate subset
gates_registered_before_measurement.G7_outside_extension: for every outside-box probe the GPU value is exactly Float32(outside_value_m)/world_per_solver with zero normal, equals the CPU value exactly, and is positive
gates_registered_before_measurement.G8_no_scalar_fallback: CUDA.allowscalar() == false throughout the fixture and no scalar-indexing exception occurs
gates_registered_before_measurement.G9_backend_identity: the observed T4 identity (GPU name/UUID/compute capability, CUDA.jl/WaterLily/Julia versions, CUDA runtime) and the T4 Project/Manifest hashes match the W0b record exactly
gates_registered_before_measurement.threshold_modification_rule: no bound relaxation after seeing a measurement; any failure is a fail-closed stop with no evidence written

ownership_contract.canonical_cpu_phi: authoritative; never replaced by a GPU-native canonical state
ownership_contract.device_phi: explicit derived copy with recorded source SHA-256
ownership_contract.margin_gate: CPU-side pre-launch only; never recomputed inside GPU kernels
ownership_contract.semantics: identical sign convention, trilinear interpolation, analytic trilinear gradient, normal = grad/|grad|

provenance.fixture: scripts/w1g_gpu_geometry_fixture.jl (gpu mode on T4; cpu mode is a local implementation-validation run only)
provenance.run_media: Colab T4 runtime driven through the colab-mcp browser connection; stdout captured into work/sdf_native_w1g_gpu_gridsdf_2026_09/

what_W1g_qualifies: a derived device GridSDF representation fed through the WaterLily body-measurement path inside a CUDA kernel
CPU/GPU geometry agreement (value, normal, sign, outside extension) within registered tolerances
what_W1g_does_not_qualify: any CFD time step or force (W2-T4b)
grid convergence or absolute aerodynamic values
